question_text: Outline two benefits of decomposing a sales program into functions for input, calculation and reporting.
adaptation_rationale: Explicitly assesses decomposition from computational thinking rather than an unsupported broad modularity slogan.
solution: Each function can be tested separately with a small clear responsibility, helping isolate defects. Independent functions with agreed interfaces can be reused or developed by different programmers, so changes are easier to manage without rewriting the whole program.
